modernRegularization.description: Clean semantic ink/muted roles, equal 640-pixel canvas/media width, 24-pixel labels, smoothed deterministic cubic curves, readable spacing and straightened source axes. These are author layout choices, not original measurements. No answer annotations.

Diagonal hatching is regenerated with uniform spacing and clipped against the unchanged conceptual a/b/baseline/profile boundaries. Individual noisy scan hatch strokes are not a counted mathematical grid. Nonzero curve endpoints remain outside both interval boundaries.

Transverse circles are represented by one consistent deterministic oblique projection, including their vertical and oblique diameters. The source is uncalibrated; its apparent radius ratio differs from Figure 98, so no metric equality between the two separate drawings is asserted. The conceptual revolution relationship, shared axial ordering, opposite radial endpoints, source line styles and all four exterior tail endpoints are preserved. This schematic regularization requires later independent visual/mathematical review.
